app.intro: A multi-economy macro-policy simulation. Explore the complete model, adjust any policy, and observe the resulting economy while the engine remains the sole authority.

scenario.sandbox.name: Free sandbox
scenario.sandbox.desc: No preset ShockTape; outcomes emerge from the simulation and player decisions
scenario.oil.name: Oil embargo

scenario.gfc.name: Global financial crisis
scenario.gfc.desc: Credit supply, demand, and productivity are disrupted

scenario.pandemic.desc: Labor, productivity, demand, credit, and optionally trade are disrupted

profile.symmetric.name: Symmetric baseline
profile.symmetric.desc: Symmetric baseline with no automatic profile overrides
profile.advanced.name: Advanced
profile.advanced.desc: High productivity, low fertility, and low mortality
profile.developing.name: Developing
profile.developing.desc: Large young population, catch-up growth, and a higher necessity share
profile.entrepot.name: Entrepot

profile.custom.name: Custom

wizard.title: New simulation
wizard.truths: Scenario, world, country structure, and initial policy are configured independently and validated together at launch.
wizard.scenario.title: Scenario
wizard.scenario.desc: Choose the exogenous shock that enters the world after this run begins.
wizard.world.title: World setup
wizard.world.desc: Set the calendar and cross-border mechanisms. Configure each country's agent population separately in the next step.
wizard.countries.stable_ids: References use stable country IDs; deletion reports affected pegs, sanctions, and scenario targets.
wizard.countries.households: Household accounts  derived by genesis matching
wizard.mapping.profile_desc: Map the edited symmetric baseline through each profile's relative multipliers
wizard.mapping.population_desc: Preserve each firm's population density when population changes; bank count is independent
wizard.government.title: Government and controller seats
wizard.government.desc: Choose the player country and seats you hold. Other countries default to no controller, so policy remains frozen at its initial state.
wizard.government.seat_count: You hold %d / 6 human seats; selected controllers operate the rest.
wizard.mode.realtime_desc: Wall-clock countdown; timeout means no action
wizard.government.calendar: Institutional decision calendar    normal mode uses natural-language summaries
wizard.calendar.quarterly_groups: Fiscal · debt · macroprudential · trade and migration · FX · energy operations
wizard.calendar.annual_groups: Taxes and transfers · structural law · energy structure
wizard.government.no_controller: No controller · policy remains unchanged from launch
wizard.policy.title: Initial policy
wizard.policy.desc: Organized by country → policy area → topic. All controls are generated live from the Policy Registry; only changes enter the difference summary.
wizard.policy.no_match: No matching policy lever—adjust the search or filter.
wizard.review.title: Founding and launch checklist
wizard.review.desc: Final values identify their source in resolution order. Review before launch.
wizard.summary.title: Run summary

settings.subtitle: Client preferences · not written to economic Config

desktop.free.header: %s · Free policy mode · all controls available; changes take effect next day
desktop.free.advance_month: Advancing 30 days; queued policy changes take effect at the start of the next day.
desktop.free.timing: Staged today and applied at the next simulation-day boundary
desktop.free.adjustment: Freely adjustable across the absolute policy domain; no step-size or minimum-hold restriction
desktop.free.cost: No adjustment cost or administrative-capacity charge
desktop.free.brief_footer: Free policy mode · Every policy area is always adjustable. The final changes made today form one atomic batch, applied before the next simulation day is calculated.

Open the policy editor; changes take effect on the next simulation day
desktop.free.no_restrictions: No meetings · no cooldown · no adjustment cost
